learner_starting_state: Can explain model/deployment choices and safe client configuration but has not yet organized the Foundry portal workflow.
learner_ending_state: Can safely orient from access and project selection through model deployment, readiness verification, portal interaction, and connection-detail handoff.
mastery_gate: Score 16 of 16 on primary and fresh-transfer forms across eight portal workflow decisions, including access, project, deployment, interaction, endpoint/deployment-name, and cleanup safeguards, then explain the flow without notes.

provenance_policy.citation_expectation: Portal workflow and current project/deployment concepts trace to official Microsoft sources; scenario wording, reasons, and gates are course-authored.
provenance_policy.unsupported_claim_behavior: Reverify portal labels/navigation, model availability, roles, regions, deployment options, quotas, pricing, preview status, endpoints, and cleanup behavior immediately before live use.

notes: Offline portal rehearsal; creates, deploys, prompts, or deletes no Azure resource.
